scope: Official public entry-plan prices and billing terms. No VM was created, no account quote or invoice was tested, and no performance comparison was run.

prices.official_excerpt: Starting Price $0.005/hr; 1 vCPU 0.5 GB RAM 10 GB storage.
prices.billing_excerpt: All other server types, including Cloud Compute, are billed up to 672 hours per month. The minimum billing unit is one hour. Stopped servers continue to incur charges; destroy a server to stop billing.

prices.observed_configuration: 1 vCPU, 512 MiB memory, 500 GiB transfer, 10 GiB SSD

interpretation_limits: The entry configurations are not identical: Vultr lists 0.5 GB RAM and does not state included transfer on the cited overview; DigitalOcean lists 512 MiB and 500 GiB transfer.
Rates are dated public list-price observations, not account-specific quotes or a guarantee of current availability by region.
These price and billing facts do not establish comparative performance or reliability.
